question:
For a set \(X\), let \(P(X)\) denote the set of all subsets of \(X\). Consider the following statements:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{(I)}&\quad P(A)\cap P(B)=P(A\cap B),\\
\text{(II)}&\quad P(A)\cup P(B)=P(A\cup B),\\
\text{(III)}&\quad P(A)=P(B)\Rightarrow A=B,\\
\text{(IV)}&\quad P(\varnothing)=\varnothing.
\end{aligned}
\]
